dimensions.assessment: Directly affects veterans suffering from chronic mild traumatic brain injury, VA facilities, and eligible entities such as academic institutions and nonprofit research organizations.
dimensions.evidence: award grants to eligible entities described in subsection (b) for the development, implementation, and evaluation of approaches... for chronic mild traumatic brain injury... in veterans.

dimensions.assessment: Funds clinical trials and treatments aimed at improving mental health outcomes, reducing suicidality, and mitigating long-term effects of brain injuries for participating veterans.
dimensions.evidence: reduce suicidality, and common risk factors for completing suicide, including depression and substance use disorders among veterans

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $10,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2028 for section 2, and another $10,000,000 annually for section 3.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary $10,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2028 to carry out this section.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes two temporary VA grant programs, third-party administrative agreements, and minor adjustments to housing loan fee expiration dates.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall carry out a three-year program... to be known as the 'TBI Innovation Grant Program'

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes programs for a three-year duration with specific termination dates.
dimensions.evidence: terminate on the date that is three years after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: Actual amounts that will be appropriated annually by Congress
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Department of Veterans Affairs to establish two distinct three-year grant programs totaling up to $20 million per year in authorized appropriations for traumatic brain injury research and neurorehabilitation.
